0.x: **First worshippers of Vasudeva-Krishna:** the **Bhagavatas** (Vasudevakas); Vasudeva worship is known from **Panini's** age.
**Originator:** **Krishna (Vasudeva)** of the **Vrishni (Satvata)** clan, son of Devaki, pupil of Ghora Angirasa (Chhandogya Upanishad).

**Earliest epigraphic evidence:** the **Garuda pillar at Besnagar** (Vidisha, c. 2nd c. BCE), set up to Vasudeva by **Heliodorus**, envoy of the Indo-Greek **Antialcidas** at the court of the Sunga **Bhagabhadra**; the Prayag prashasti, Nasik and Ayodhya records are later.
**Doctrine:** **bhakti**, **ahimsa**, the **avatara** theory – **ten incarnations**; open to women, Vaishyas, Shudras and foreigners.

r: Greatest contribution to the Bhagavata sect – virtually the state religion; rulers styled **Parama Bhagavata** (first: **Samudragupta**); dynastic emblem **Garuda**
Salankayanas were Vaishnavas (title Parama Mahesvara); Pedavegi inscription of Nandivarman II – first AP record of Vishnu temples

0.x: **Varaha (boar):** The incarnation that **saved the Earth from the sea**, lifting her on his tusks after killing **Hiranyaksha**
**Dashavatara:** Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narasimha, Vamana, Parashurama, Rama, Krishna, Buddha, Kalki.
**Kaustubha (Kausthubham):** The gem on **Vishnu's chest**, from the churning of the ocean.

r: Followers of Kalanana (disciple of Lakulisha); extremist; Simha Parishat in Andhra
Skull-bearing **Vamacharas**; worshippers of Kapalini; Bhairava worship; Srisailam a Kapalika kshetra; Bhairavakonda caves

1.x: Other names: Ajivika (Makkhali Gosala); Mayamata – a text on architecture; Isanasivagurudeva Paddhati – a ritual manual.
**Gudimallam** (Tirupati district): the earliest known Shiva linga; the Gupta **ekamukhalinga** = a linga with one face.
**Kakatiya link:** the **Kalamukha and Pashupata** sects later flourished under the Kakatiyas.

r: Half Shiva, half Parvati = the **union of God with his Shakti**
Spread from the **5th century**; open to women and Shudras

1.x: **18 Mahapuranas**; took their final shape in the **Gupta period**; five topics (**pancha-lakshana**): creation, re-creation, genealogies, manvantaras, dynastic history.
**Surya worship:** the silk-weavers' guild built a **Sun temple at Mandsaur** under **Kumaragupta I**; Skandagupta's **Indore** plate endows a lamp in a Sun temple.

2.x: **Earliest free-standing Hindu temples** survive from the **Gupta** age: square **garbhagriha**, pillared mandapa, raised **jagati**.

r: Flat roof, square sanctum, shallow portico
Covered ambulatory, raised platform; Bhumara has two flanking shrines
Low square **shikhara**; Panchayatana plan; these Stage-3 temples mark the beginning of the **Nagara** style

2.x: **Dashavatara temple, Deogarh:** in **Lalitpur** district near **Jhansi** (UP); **Gupta** period; Vishnu and his ten avatars; the earliest **Panchayatana** temple of North India.
**Panchayatana:** a **style of temple construction** – a main shrine plus **four subsidiary shrines** at the corners.
**Deogarh and Garhwa:** the Deogarh temple near Jhansi and the sculptures of **Garhwa** near Allahabad (Prayagraj) are remains of **Gupta art**.
**Bhitargaon** (near Kanpur): a **brick and terracotta** Hindu temple, built c. **5th–6th c. CE** – one of the **oldest surviving brick temples** of India.

r: Ghazipur – Skandagupta's pillar and excavated Gupta Vishnu temples

2.x: **Dravida vs Nagara:** the **Virupaksha temple, Pattadakal** has a **Dravida** vimana; Deogarh, Bhitargaon and Huchimalligudi (Aihole) carry Nagara-type shikharas.

r: Indra's thunderbolt, made from the **backbone of sage Dadhichi**

3.x: Sectarian symbols on Gupta coins and seals

r: Lost royal patronage; overshadowed by Bhagavatism
Under **Devarddhi Kshamashramana**; wrote down the **Svetambara** canon

4.x: **Tolerance:** Samudragupta let **Meghavarman** of Sri Lanka build a monastery at Bodh Gaya; **Amrakardava**, Chandragupta II's officer, made a grant at Sanchi.
**Purusharthas:** dharma, artha, kama, moksha – the first three = **trivarga**; devotional Hinduism replaced sacrificial Brahmanism.
